findings.title: StorageClass does not exist
findings.cause: PersistentVolumeClaim data asks for StorageClass fast-ssd, which does not exist (the cluster has standard (default))

evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pvc-missing-storageclass -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'
kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pvc-missing-storageclass -o jsonpath='{.spec.storageClassName}'

evidence.what: no StorageClass is named fast-ssd; the cluster has standard (default)

findings.fix: Set storageClassName to a class that exists, or create StorageClass fast-ssd. A claim's class cannot be changed: recreate the claim.
